title: Enterprise Brand Trust & Lead Generation
challenge: The brand required consistent enterprise enquiries but lacked structured credibility signals in a competitive B2B technology ecosystem.
strategy: Enterprise buyers do not respond to generic capability messaging. They respond to visible proof, contextual relevance, and delivery maturity. Marcom Express shifted positioning from lead generation to credibility-led brand storytelling, built a structured video case-study system anchored in real customer outcomes, developed messaging aligned to enterprise decision-makers, and integrated CRM to support sustained enquiries.
impact: Strengthened enterprise brand credibility.
Improved engagement with enterprise buyers.
Enabled more effective sales conversations through proof-based communication.
Established a scalable content framework supporting long-term demand generation.

title: Building Brand Reach & Presence Through Thought Leadership
challenge: Delta Electronics sought to strengthen its brand presence in the Indian market. Product-focused content created awareness, but the brand needed a differentiated approach to establish credibility, showcase its market perspective, and position itself as a trusted industry leader.
strategy: Developed a CXO-led thought leadership video series showcasing Delta Electronics' vision, industry insights, and market perspective. Executive voices turned leadership expertise into strategic brand content for customers, partners, and industry stakeholders.
impact: Elevated Delta Electronics' executive and brand visibility.
Strengthened thought leadership positioning in the Indian market.
Increased social media engagement through brand mentions, likes, and shares.
Enhanced audience confidence by positioning Delta Electronics as an industry voice.

title: Building Brand Trust Through Purpose-Led Storytelling
challenge: Delta Electronics aimed to maximize the impact of its CSR initiatives while building meaningful brand awareness and recognition. The challenge was to communicate lasting value for rural communities beyond project announcements.
strategy: Created a storytelling-led case study video featuring leadership and beneficiaries. It captured initiatives such as smart classrooms, hygienic sanitation facilities, and water restoration projects supporting education and agricultural livelihoods.
impact: Strengthened reputation as a socially responsible organization.
Generated positive PR coverage and organic brand mentions.
Increased brand visibility and engagement through authentic storytelling.
Showcased community impact beyond CSR compliance.

title: Building Employer Brand Through Authentic Storytelling
challenge: Delta Electronics sought to attract top engineering talent from India's premier institutions and differentiate itself in a competitive talent market.
strategy: Developed an employer branding strategy centered on authentic storytelling, including employee testimonial videos about career journeys, learning opportunities and workplace culture, leadership perspectives, and an employer value proposition for young engineering talent.
impact: Strengthened the employer brand among engineering graduates.
Increased brand awareness and consideration during campus engagement initiatives.
Enhanced trust through authentic employee and leadership stories.
Positioned Delta Electronics as an innovation-driven workplace offering career growth.

title: Building Long-Term Partner Loyalty Through Strategic Communication
challenge: The IT Division's People–Partner–Performance (P3) program needed to strengthen engagement with premium channel partners, many of whom also represented competing infrastructure brands. The challenge extended beyond certification to long-term brand affinity and partner preference.
strategy: Designed an integrated communication and engagement framework around the P3 certification journey, using strategic storytelling, executive messaging, recognition programs, experiential events, testimonial films, and branded content.
impact: Strengthened brand affinity and recall among strategic channel partners.
Reinforced partner confidence in Schneider Electric's long-term commitment and sustained partner preference.

title: Authority Positioning & Enterprise Trust Building
challenge: Schneider needed a scalable way to engage enterprise stakeholders beyond transactional campaigns.
strategy: Created dedicated thought-leadership content, positioned the brand as a domain authority in critical power solutions, structured content around enterprise concerns such as risk, reliability and efficiency, and maintained consistency in tone of voice and subject matter governance.
impact: Created a scalable pipeline of high-intent enterprise engagement.

title: Strategic GTM Positioning & Enterprise Adoption: Modicon Product Launch
challenge: Schneider Electric was launching Modicon in a competitive automation and industrial solutions market. The challenge was to position it as a credible, enterprise-ready solution aligned with operational reliability and future scalability.
strategy: Defined an enterprise-focused positioning narrative, shifted communication from features to business impact, leveraged customer stories, designed digital-first amplification, and built a landing ecosystem for product demos and enquiries.
impact: Higher product recall among the target audience.
Improved engagement rates.
150+ MQL leads during the one-month campaign.
Strengthened perception of Schneider as an automation authority.

title: Building an Expert Community to Influence Specification Decisions
challenge: Schneider Electric sought sustained engagement with power and cooling consultants beyond one-time events, strengthening relationships with an audience influencing technology specification and purchase decisions.
strategy: Designed a digital knowledge-sharing community, curated expert-led content, facilitated peer-to-peer exchange, positioned Schneider Electric as a knowledge partner, and enabled continuous engagement through an always-on platform.
impact: Onboarded 2,500+ high-value consultants.
Strengthened long-term engagement and ecosystem loyalty.
Elevated Schneider Electric's positioning from vendor to trusted industry partner.

title: Strategic Brand Amplification and Authority Positioning
challenge: In India's competitive construction equipment market, Volvo CE needed stronger market signals to reinforce brand visibility, perceived leadership and preference.
strategy: Repositioned Excon as a brand-signalling moment rather than a standalone lead-generation event. Built an integrated digital-first brand architecture, leadership-led video narratives, a landing ecosystem for product demos and CXO interactions, and YouTube and digital amplification.
impact: 12M+ reach.
150+ leads.
1.8M YouTube views, reinforcing leadership visibility.

title: Building Brand Preference Through Community-Led Engagement
challenge: Strengthen long-term brand preference for SOLIDWORKS among 3D design professionals across APAC while influencing enterprise software adoption through sustained community engagement.
strategy: Developed a centralized technical community platform, curated expert-led and user-generated technical content, and fostered peer-to-peer knowledge sharing to reinforce brand credibility and engagement.
impact: 30K+ community members (as stated in the presentation).
20K license subscriptions.
Strengthened technical brand preference across APAC.

title: Building a Digital Brand Foundation for Consumer Trust
challenge: Essilor had limited direct engagement with consumers in India and lacked a cohesive digital presence. It needed to establish visibility, educate consumers about vision care, and create a digital ecosystem that could influence purchase decisions.
strategy: Defined digital brand positioning and messaging, developed a unified educational content strategy, led cross-functional content, creative and technology teams, and aligned storytelling with business and brand objectives.
impact: Attracted 1M+ website visitors.
Grew a 200,000+ member digital community.
Established Essilor as a trusted consumer brand for vision care in India.
Built a scalable digital foundation for long-term brand growth.

title: Building Brand Reputation Through Purpose-Led Communication Strategy
challenge: Strengthen Fujitsu's brand perception within India's technology and education ecosystem through a scholarship initiative, building credibility, trust and engagement despite a limited marketing budget.
strategy: Developed a purpose-led communication strategy aligned with Fujitsu's global brand values, positioned the scholarship as an investment in future innovation, and created an integrated ecosystem of campaign messaging, digital assets, case studies, email journeys and CRM-led outreach.
impact: Reached 100,000+ prospective students and stakeholders.
Generated 352 scholarship applications.
Strengthened Fujitsu's reputation in the education and technology ecosystem.
Received the Best Marketing Excellence Award at the Paul Writer Summit 2017.
